source: hand-curated snapshot inspired by redteams.ai/navigator and MITRE ATLAS

tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.description: Information gathering about target LLM systems, capabilities, and guardrails.

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.description: Unauthorized interaction entry points and prompt injection surfaces.

tactics.name: Execution
tactics.description: Causing the model to produce disallowed outputs or run unauthorized actions.

tactics.name: Persistence
tactics.description: Maintaining influence over model behavior across turns, sessions, or contexts.

tactics.name: Privilege Escalation
tactics.description: Bypassing safety, role, or permission boundaries.

tactics.name: Defense Evasion
tactics.description: Evading detection by safety classifiers, refusal training, or system-prompt guardrails.

tactics.name: Collection
tactics.description: Extracting system prompts, training data hints, or PII from the model.

tactics.name: Exfiltration
tactics.description: Moving extracted content out via prompt-visible channels.

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.description: Causing downstream harm through model output or tool use.

techniques.name: Model fingerprinting
techniques.description: Probe outputs to identify model family, version, or system prompt.

techniques.name: Guardrail probing
techniques.description: Send borderline requests to map refusal boundaries.

techniques.name: Capability enumeration
techniques.description: Ask about tools, functions, and available integrations to discover attack surface.

techniques.name: Direct prompt injection
techniques.description: Instructions concatenated into user input to override system behavior.

techniques.name: Indirect prompt injection
techniques.description: Malicious instructions delivered via retrieved documents, tool outputs, or embedded content.

techniques.name: Multi-modal injection
techniques.description: Adversarial instructions in images, audio, or attached files.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — DAN family
techniques.description: "Do Anything Now" style persona instructions.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — roleplay/persona
techniques.description: Adopt a fictional persona with different constraints.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — hypothetical framing
techniques.description: Frame the request as fiction, thought experiment, or academic analysis.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — authority appeal
techniques.description: Claim authorization or urgent legitimate need to override refusals.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — payload splitting
techniques.description: Break disallowed content into pieces the model assembles.

techniques.name: Jailbreak — token smuggling
techniques.description: Use unusual tokenization tricks (e.g., unicode variants) to slip past filters.

techniques.name: System-prompt override
techniques.description: Convince the model to adopt a new persistent system instruction for the session.

techniques.name: Context stuffing
techniques.description: Fill the context window to push safety instructions out of attention.

techniques.name: Multi-turn drift (Crescendo)
techniques.description: Escalate incrementally so each step feels like a small extension of the last.

techniques.name: Tool-use abuse
techniques.description: Induce model to invoke tools/functions in disallowed ways.

techniques.name: Sandbox escape via output
techniques.description: Craft outputs that a downstream tool interprets as commands.

techniques.name: Encoding — base64/rot13/leetspeak
techniques.description: Encode disallowed content so classifiers miss it.

techniques.name: Cipher (Caesar / substitution)
techniques.description: Simple ciphers that the model can decode but classifiers cannot.

techniques.name: Low-resource language
techniques.description: Ask in a language less well-covered by safety training.

techniques.name: Chain-of-thought hijack
techniques.description: Instruct the model to reason step-by-step in ways that bypass surface refusals.

techniques.name: Refusal suppression
techniques.description: Explicitly instruct the model to avoid refusal templates.

techniques.name: Adversarial suffix (GCG-style)
techniques.description: Append short adversarial strings that flip the model's decision (typically found via optimization; hand-crafted variants also exist).

techniques.name: System-prompt extraction
techniques.description: Get the model to reveal its own hidden instructions.

techniques.name: Training-data probing
techniques.description: Elicit memorized text or PII from training data.

techniques.name: Preference/config leak
techniques.description: Reveal internal configuration, tools, or safety hints.

techniques.name: Encoding output
techniques.description: Force the model to emit sensitive content in an encoded form to bypass output filters.

techniques.name: Steganographic response
techniques.description: Hide payload in ostensibly benign output.

techniques.name: Harmful content generation
techniques.description: Elicit disallowed content categories: violence, illegal, CSAM refusal bypass, etc.

techniques.name: Targeted disinformation
techniques.description: Produce plausible false content aimed at specific targets.

techniques.name: Fraud / social engineering payload
techniques.description: Craft phishing, scam scripts, impersonation content.
